STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r27.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r27.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r27.claim: The discussion returns to the Israelites' later disobedience and the future punishments they are said to suffer for it.
STUDYQURAN:7:intro/r27.anchor: the Israelites’ later disobedience and the future punishments they are said to suffer as a result (vv. 159–71)

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-3-surah-araf-07:p136.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-3-surah-araf-07:p136.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-3-surah-araf-07:p136.claim: Persevering in prayer signifies firm adherence to Scripture and guards God's covenant; the verse encourages a small truth-preserving group among the People of the Book, later converts to the final Prophet.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-3-surah-araf-07:p136.anchor: In my opinion, this verse sounds an encouragement to a small group among the People of the Book who adhered to the truth

IBNMUJAHID:v1p297/r1.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p297/r1.speaker: أبو عمرو
IBNMUJAHID:v1p297/r1.claim: Abu Amr reads يمسكون and ولا تمسكوا with doubled consonants; he alone doubles ولا تمسكوا, while the others lighten it.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p297/r1.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو ﴿ يمسكون ﴾ ﴿ ولا تمسكوا ﴾ مضمومتى الياء والتاء مشددتين

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r1.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r1.claim: Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim reads yumsikūn with a light mīm-sīn, while the common reading doubles the sīn.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r1.anchor: قرأ أبو بكر عن عاصم: "يمسكون" بالتخفيف، وقراءة العامة بالتشديد

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r2.claim: The doubled form is justified by saying masaktu bi-sh-shayʾ, whereas amsaktu takes a direct object: amsaktuhu.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r2.anchor: لأنه يقال: مسكت بالشيء، ولا يقال أمسكت بالشيء، إنما يقال: أمسكته

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r3.speaker: أبي بن كعب
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r3.claim: Ubayy reads ‘those who held fast’ in the past tense; this fits the following past-tense ‘they established prayer,’ since a past verb rarely coordinates with a present one except in meaning.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r3.anchor: وقرأ أبي بن كعب: "والذين تمسكوا بالكتاب"، على الماضي وهو جيد لقوله تعالى: {وأقاموا الصلاة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r4.claim: Those who hold fast are people who act according to the Book.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r4.anchor: وأراد] (1) الذين يعملون بما في الكتاب، قال مجاهد

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r5.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r5.claim: Mujāhid identifies them as believers among the People of the Book, including ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām and his companions, who did not distort, conceal, or exploit Moses’ Book for livelihood.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r5.anchor: قال مجاهد: هم المؤمنون من أهل الكتاب، عبد الله بن سلام وأصحابه، تمسكوا بالكتاب الذي جاء به موسى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r6.speaker: عطاء
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r6.claim: ʿAṭāʾ identifies them as the community of Muḥammad.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v3p297/r6.anchor: وقال عطاء: هم أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

NAHHAS:v2p160/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p160/r6.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v2p160/r6.claim: Alladhīna yumsikūna is the beginning of a clause, whose implied predicate is that God does not waste the reformers' reward among them.
NAHHAS:v2p160/r6.anchor: ابتداء والتقدير في خبره ( إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين ) منهم

NAHHAS:v2p160/r7.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p160/r7.speaker: أبو العالية
NAHHAS:v2p160/r7.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya and ʿĀṣim read yumsikūna bi-l-kitāb; ordinary Arabic says masaktu or amsaktuhu, and the latter form is also in Qurʾānic usage.
NAHHAS:v2p160/r7.anchor: وقرأ أبو العالية وعاصم ( والذين يمسكون بالكتاب ) وكلام العرب على غير هذا يقولون مسكت وأمسكته

NAHHAS:v2p160/r8.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v2p160/r8.speaker: كعب بن زهير
NAHHAS:v2p160/r8.claim: Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr naturally uses tamassaka in his poem about a rope that cannot hold water, illustrating the Arabic verb form.
NAHHAS:v2p160/r8.anchor: وقال كعب ابن زهير فجاء به على طبعه

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r1.claim: The more apparent analysis makes والذين يمسكون a subject, with several possible predicates.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r1.anchor: فيه وجهان، أظهرهما: أنه مبتدأ، وفي خبره حينئذ [أوجه]

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r2.claim: One predicate analysis takes إنا لا نضيع as predicate, with an understood linker المصلحين منهم, following most Basrans.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r2.anchor: أحدها: أنه ضمير محذوف لفهم المعنى. والتقدير: المصلحين منهم، وهذا على قواعد جمهور البصريين

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r3.claim: The Kufan account lets the definite article stand for a pronoun, yielding أجر مصلحيهم; examples are drawn from 79:41, 38:50, and 30:3.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r3.anchor: وقواعد الكوفيين تقتضي أن أل قائمة مقام الضمير تقديره: أجر مصلحيهم كقوله:

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r4.speaker: الأخفش
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r4.claim: Al-Akhfash allows semantic repetition of the subject as the clause's linker, as in nominal and relative-clause examples.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r4.anchor: والثاني: أن الرابط تكرر المبتدأ بمعناه نحو: زيد قام أبو عبد الله وهو رأي الأخفش

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r5.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r5.claim: Abu al-Baqa treats the generality of المصلحين as the linker: the subject is one member of that class, so a pronoun is unnecessary.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r5.anchor: الثالث: أن الرابط هو العموم في " المصلحين " قاله أبو البقاء

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r6.claim: The author accepts generality as a linker and cites ألا ليت شعري and نعم الرجل زيد as evidence.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r6.anchor: قلت: العموم رابط من الروابط الخمسة وعليه قوله:

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r7.speaker: الحوفي
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r7.claim: Al-Hawfi supplies an omitted predicate such as rewarded and treats إنا لا نضيع as parenthetical; the author says this is unnecessary.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r7.anchor: والوجه الثاني من وجهي الخبر أنه محذوف تقديره: والذين يمسكون مأجورون أو مثابون ونحوه، وقوله: " إنا لا نضيع "

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r8.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r8.claim: Al-Zamakhshari coordinates والذين in the genitive with للذين يتقون, meaning the hereafter is good for the pious and those holding scripture; he calls إنا لا نضيع parenthetical.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r8.anchor: قاله الزمخشري، إلا أنه قال: " ويكون قوله

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r9.claim: The author objects that this clause is not parenthetical between syntactically connected elements; it should be called independent on that analysis.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r9.anchor: وفيه نظر لأنه لم يقع بين شيئين متلازمين

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r10.speaker: الجمهور
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r10.claim: The common reading has geminated sīn from مسك meaning تمسك; إن can carry the sense of تفعّل and bāʾ marks the instrument, as in holding a rope.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r10.anchor: وقرأ العامة: " يمسكون " بالتشديد من مسك بمعنى تمسك، حكاه أهل التصريف

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r11.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم وأبو عمرو وأبو العالية
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r11.claim: Abu Bakr from Asim reads with a light sīn and still mīm, as reported from Abu Amr and Abu al-Aliya; it is from أمسك, a transitive verb.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r11.anchor: وقرأ أبو بكر عن عاصم ورويت عن أبي عمرو وأبي العالية: " يمسكون " بسكون الميم وتخفيف السين من أمسك

SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r12.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r12.speaker: كعب بن زهير
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r12.claim: Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr's cited couplet combines تمسك and يمسك as evidence for the two forms.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170/r12.anchor: وقد جمع كعب بن زهير بينهما في قوله:

SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r1.claim: The couplet cited by Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr contrasts holding to a covenant with water held by sieves.

SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r2.claim: On the light form from أمسك, the omitted object is their religion and deeds held by the Book; bāʾ may mark circumstance or instrument, namely its commands and prohibitions.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r2.anchor: ولكن أمسك متعد. قال تعالى: ويمسك السمآء

SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r3.speaker: الأعمش وأبي
SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r3.claim: Al-Aʿmash's reading, also attributed to Ubayy, has the past forms استمسكوا and تمسكوا.
SAMIN-DURR:7:170#2/r3.anchor: وقرأ الأعمش وهي قراءة عبد الله " استمسكوا ". وأبي " تمسكوا " ماضيين

ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r5.claim: Alladhīna is nominative; the issue is how to link the promise that God does not waste the reformers' reward to those who hold the Book.
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r5.anchor: في موضع رفع، وفيها قولان، أعني في (إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين)

ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r6.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r6.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r6.claim: Zajjaj prefers that the promise means the reformers among them: nonbelievers' good deeds are lost, and a reformer is a believer who remains faithful and fulfills duties in belief and practice.
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r6.anchor: قال قوم: إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين منهم، وهو الذي نختار

ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r7.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r7.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r7.claim: Holding the Book means believing it and judging by its contents; the reformer among them stays in faith and performs its obligations in conviction and action.
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r7.anchor: أي يؤمنون به، ويحكمون بما فيه إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلح منهم والمصلح المقيم على الإيمان

ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r8.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r8.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r8.claim: The parallel promise that God does not waste the reward of one who does good likewise means those who do good among the believers.
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r8.anchor: أي لا نضيع أجر من أحسن منهم عملا

ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r9.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r9.speaker: قوم
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r9.claim: Others say the word reformers changes form from its antecedent while referring to the same people in sense; a semantic antecedent can license the return reference.
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r9.anchor: وقال قوم: المصلحون لفظ يخالف لفظ الأول، ومعناه معنى الأول

ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r10.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r10.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r10.claim: Zajjaj distinguishes a mere name from a semantic equivalent: one cannot say Zayd stood, Abu Amr, but can equate believer with one who fears God and resume it with a pronoun.
ZAJJAJ:v2p388/r10.anchor: لأن معنى من اتقى الله معنى المؤمن، فقد صار بمنزلة قولك زيد ضربته

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p760/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p760/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p760/r1.claim: The general “reward of the reformers,” rather than “their reward,” includes the people holding fast to the Book among the broader class of reformers.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p760/r1.anchor: جاءت للعموم ولم يقل تعالى (لا نضيع أجرهم) للأفراد وكلمة (أجرهم) تفيد أن المذكورين دخلوا في المصلحين

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r1.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r1.claim: Abū Bakr’s transmission from ʿĀṣim alone lightens the sīn in يمسكون; Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim and the other named readers geminate it. Al-Fārisī prefers the widespread geminated reading, which suits holding the whole Book.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r1.anchor: فقرأ عاصم وحده في رواية أبي بكر: والذين يمسكون خفيفا

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r2.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r2.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r2.claim: The light form is supported by the related noun and verb إمساك، أمسك, and أمسكن, all built on the same root.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r2.anchor: حجة من قرأ: يمسكون بتخفيف السين قوله: فإمساك بمعروف

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r3.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r3.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r3.claim: Gemination is more apt for steadfastly holding to the Scripture as a whole; it contrasts with those who claim to believe in part of revelation and disbelieve in part.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r3.anchor: وقول الجميع: يمسكون بالكتاب أولى من الرواية التي انفرد بها

FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r4.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r4.speaker: أبو عمرو
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r4.claim: Abū ʿAmr alone geminates the tāʾ and sīn in ولا تمسكوا; all other readers lighten it. Al-Fārisī accepts the lighter form as fitting the Qur’anic usage for retaining a wife, while noting أفعل and فعّل can coincide in meaning.
FARISI-HUJJA:v4p102/r4.anchor: انفرد أبو عمرو بقوله: ولا تمسكوا أنها مشددة، والباقون يخففونها

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r4.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r4.speaker: author
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r4.claim: The doubled reading derives from masaka yumsiku and conveys renewed adherence; Ubayy's reading has the related doubled form.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r4.anchor: فالحجة لمن شدد أنه أخذه من مسك يمسك إذا عاود فعل التمسك بالشيء

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r5.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r5.speaker: author
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r5.claim: The light reading derives from amsaka yumsiku, supported by the wording hold on to your wife.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p166/r5.anchor: والحجة لمن خفف أنه أخذه من أمسك يمسك

IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r9.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r9.speaker: عاصم عن أبي بكر
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r9.claim: Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim lightens يمسكون and also تمسكوا in al-Mumtaḥana.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r9.anchor: فقرأ عاصم وحده فى رواية أبى بكر ﴿ يمسكون ﴾ خفيفة وكذلك قرأ ﴿ ولا تمسكوا بعصم الكوافر ﴾ الممتحنة 10

IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r10.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r10.speaker: حفص عن عاصم
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r10.claim: Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim doubles يمسكون but lightens تمسكوا in al-Mumtaḥana.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r10.anchor: وروى حفص عن عاصم ﴿ يمسكون ﴾ مشددة ﴿ ولا تمسكوا ﴾ خفيفة

IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r11.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r11.speaker: ابن كثير، نافع، ابن عامر، حمزة، الكسائي
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r11.claim: These readers double يمسكون and lighten تمسكوا in al-Mumtaḥana.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p296/r11.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير ونافع وابن عامر وحمزة والكسائى ﴿ والذين يمسكون ﴾ مشددة ﴿ ولا تمسكوا ﴾ مخففة

QIRAAT-ER:7:170:3#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:7:170:3#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:7:170:3#1/r1.claim: Form IV yumsikūna indicates simple retention, while Form II yumassikūna conveys intensive, repeated grasping or effortful clinging.
QIRAAT-ER:7:170:3#1/r1.anchor: Form IV yumsikūna vs standard Form II yumassikūna — IV = simple retention

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r1.claim: The apparent referent of الكتاب is the same scripture inherited in 7:169, so the same disagreement applies; another view takes it as all divine books.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r1.anchor: الظاهر أن الكتاب هو السابق ذكره في ورثوا الكتاب فيجيء الخلاف فيه كالخلاف في ذلك

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r2.claim: Holding to scripture entails establishing prayer, but prayer is named separately to honor its status as religion's pillar and the boundary between a servant and shirk.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r2.anchor: والتمسك بالكتاب يستلزم إقامة الصلاة لكنها أفردت بالذكر تعظيما لشأنها لأنها عماد الدين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r3.speaker: عمر وأبو العالية وأبو بكر عن عاصم
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r3.claim: ʿUmar, Abū al-ʿĀliya, and Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim read يمسكون from أمسك.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r3.anchor: وقرأ عمر وأبو العالية وأبو بكر عن عاصم يمسكون من أمسك

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r4.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r4.claim: The majority read the intensified form يمسكون from مسك; both forms are dialectal synonyms, illustrated by Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr's line.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r5.claim: أمسك is transitive, as in 22:65; here its omitted object is their deeds, and the attached باء may express state or instrument.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r6.claim: With the doubled form, مسك means تمسك and باء marks the instrument; the morphological pattern فعل can also carry the sense of تفعل.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r6.anchor: ومسك مشدد بمعنى تمسك والباء معها للآلة وفعل تأتي بمعنى تفعل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r7.speaker: عبد الله والأعمش
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r7.claim: ʿAbd Allāh and al-Aʿmash read استمسكوا; Ubayy's codex has تمسكوا بالكتاب.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r8.claim: The apparent syntax starts a new sentence: والذين is a nominative topic and the following sentence is its predicate, with the general reference to المصلحين supplying the link.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r8.anchor: والظاهر أن قوله والذين استئناف إخبار لما ذكر حال من لم يتمسك بالكتاب

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r9.speaker: الحوفي وأبو البقاء
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r9.claim: Al-Ḥawfī and Abū al-Baqāʾ posit an omitted link, such as they are rewarded or We reward them; Abū Ḥayyān says deletion is unnecessary.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r9.anchor: وقال الحوفي وأبو البقاء: الرابط محذوف تقديره أجر المصلحين اعتراض

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r10.speaker: أبو البقاء
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r10.claim: Abū al-Baqāʾ also allows المصلحين to stand for a pronoun meaning their reward, following al-Akhfash's view of the clause link.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r10.anchor: وأجاز أبو البقاء أن يكون الرابط هو المصلحين وضعه موضع المضمر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r11.speaker: الزمخشري وابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r11.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī and Ibn ʿAṭiyya allow والذين to be genitive, coordinated with الذين يتقون in 7:169; Abū Ḥayyān prefers a new sentence.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p211/r11.anchor: وأجاز الزمخشري أن يكون والذين في موضع جر عطفا على الذين يتقون

ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r1.claim: The phrase means holding fast to the Book in religious matters; مسك به and تمسك به are equivalent expressions.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r1.anchor: أي يتمسكون به في أمور دينهم

ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r2.speaker: مجاهد وابن زيد
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r2.claim: Mujahid and Ibn Zayd identify them as believers from the People of the Book, such as Abdullah ibn Salam and his companions, who neither distorted nor concealed Moses’ Book nor profited from it.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r2.anchor: قال مجاهد وابن زيد : هم الذين آمنوا من أهل الكتاب كعبدالله بن سلام

ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r3.speaker: عطاء
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r3.claim: Ata identifies them as Muhammad’s community and takes the Book to mean the Quran.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r3.anchor: وقال عطاء : هم أمة محمد صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم

ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r4.speaker: أبوبكر وحماد وابن مسعود وأبي
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r4.claim: Abu Bakr and Hammad read يمسكون with a light form meaning hold; Ibn Masud reads استمسكوا and Ubay reads مسكوا, agreeing with the following verb.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r4.anchor: وقرأ أبوبكر وحماد ( يمسكون ) بالتخفيف من الإمساك

ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r5.claim: The well-known form signals continuous adherence across all times, whereas prayer is performed at prescribed times; prayer is singled out because it is the pillar of religion.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r5.anchor: للدلالة على أن التمسك أمر مستمر في جميع الأزمنة بخلاف الإقامة فإنها مختصة بالأوقات المخصوصة

ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r6.claim: Prayer is singled out from other acts despite being included in adherence to the Book because it surpasses them as the support of religion.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r6.anchor: وتخصيصها بالذكر من بين سائر العبادات مع دخولها بالتمسك بالكتاب لإنافتها عليها لأنها عماد الدين

ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r7.claim: The relative clause may be genitive, coordinated with الذين يتقون; alternatively it is nominative as a subject whose predicate is إنا لا نضيع.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r7.anchor: محل الموصول إما الجر عطفا على الذين يتقون

ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r8.claim: For the subject analysis, the predicate’s link may be an omitted منهم pronoun per most Basrans, the article per Kufans, or the generic noun المصلحين; alternatively the overt noun replaces an original pronoun and signals that righteousness prevents loss of reward.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r8.anchor: الرابط إما الضمير المحذوف كما هو رأي جمهور البصريين أي أجر المصلحين منهم وإما الألف واللام

ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r9.claim: A further parse supplies a missing predicate, meaning those who hold the Book are rewarded; the promise then parenthetically confirms it.
ALUSI-FULL:v9p98#2/r9.anchor: وقيل : الخبر محذوف والتقدير والذين يمسكون بالكتاب

BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r1.claim: The promise to the reformers contrasts with the preceding corruptors, who falsified claims about God and spoiled the book; Biqaʿi connects the righteous to the community in 7:159.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r1.anchor: بين ما للمفسدين من كونهم قالوا على الله غير الحق

BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r2.claim: Holding the book means clinging to it continuously and firmly, a difficult commitment especially when corruption is widespread, so they do not falsely speak about God.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r2.anchor: يمسكون إمساكا شديدا يتجدد على كل وجه

BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r3.claim: True adherence to a revealed book includes leaving it for its abrogating successor, since the earlier book itself testifies to the abrogation.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r3.anchor: ومن جملة تمسيكهم المتجدد انتقالهم عن ذلك الكتاب عند إتيان الناسخ

BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r4.claim: Biqaʿi explains the past-tense wording for prayer as preventing the former community from using its established prayer as an argument to remain in its old religion.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r4.anchor: عبر عن إقامة الصلاة المعهودة لهم بلفظ الماضي دون المضارع لئلا يجعلوه حجة

BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r5.claim: Prayer is singled out because earlier people had abandoned it, as stated in the verse in Maryam, and because it is one of religion's greatest rites.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r5.anchor: وخصها إشارة إلى أن الأولين توكوها كما صرح به في آية مريم

BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p146/r6.claim: God's promise generalizes the reward to all reformers and assures that none of their recompense will be lost in any way.

BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r1.claim: “And those” continues the prior praise: the afterlife is also better for those who hold fast to the Book.
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r1.anchor: والذين} أي : وخير أيضا للذين {يمسكون بالكتاب}

BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r2.claim: Holding fast to the Book means adhering to it in religious affairs.
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r2.anchor: أي : يتمسكون به في أمور دينهم يقال مسك بالشيء وتمسك به

BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r3.speaker: مجاهد
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r3.claim: Mujahid identifies them as believers from the People of the Book, such as Abdullah ibn Salam and his companions, who kept Moses’s Book without distortion, concealment, or using it to take people’s money.
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r3.anchor: قال مجاهد : هم الذين آمنوا من أهل الكتاب كعبد الله بن سلام وأصحابه تمسكوا بالكتاب الذي جاء به موسى

BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r4.speaker: عطاء
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r4.claim: Ata identifies them as Muhammad’s community and the Book as the Qur’an.
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r4.anchor: وقال عطاء : هم أمة محمد عليه السلام فالمراد بالكتاب القرآن.

BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r5.claim: Prayer is singled out after the general command to adhere to scripture to honor its rank: after faith it is the greatest act of worship.
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r5.anchor: من قبيل ذكر الخاص بعد ذكر العام للتنبيه على شرف الخاص وفضله فإن إقامة الصلاة أعظم العبادات وأفضلها بعد الإيمان

BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p206#2/r6.claim: The Persian couplet pictures prayer as the pillar on which God built the house of religion, and whose standing sustains the true faith.

BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r1.claim: God will give reformers their reward for what they say and do.
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r1.anchor: أي : نعطيهم أجرهم في القول والعمل

BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r2.speaker: الكاشفي
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r2.claim: Al-Kashifi glosses the promise as fully delivering the pay of those who act righteously.
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r2.anchor: قال الكاشفي : (مزدكار بصلاح آرند كان كردار خودرا بلكه بتمام بديشان رسانيم).

BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r3.claim: Reform includes outward obedience and inward purification, disciplining the self until it can receive the effusion of God’s light.
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r3.anchor: وإما إصلاح السرائر وذلك بالتقيد بالأعمال الظاهرة

BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r4.claim: In the latter days people commonly abandon the Qur’an; wretched successors after the blessed become settled in worldly adornments.
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r4.anchor: واعلم : أن الغالب في آخر الزمان ترك العمل بالقرآن ولقد خلف من بعد السعداء أشقياء اطمأنوا إلى زخارف الدنيا.

BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r5.speaker: الحسن
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r5.claim: Hasan says he saw seventy veterans of Badr more abstinent from lawful things than people are from unlawful ones, and more joyful in hardship than people are in ease; they seemed mad to later people, and feared lawful wealth would corrupt their hearts.
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r5.anchor: قال الحسن : رأيت سبعين بدريا كانوا فيما أحل الله لهم أزهد منكم فيما حرم الله عليكم وكانوا بالبلاء أشد منكم فرحا بالرخاء

BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r6.speaker: هرم وأويس
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r6.claim: When Hurm asked Uways where to live and how Syria’s livelihood was, Uways lamented that doubt had entered hearts so deeply that admonition no longer benefits them.
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r6.anchor: قال هرم لأويس : أين تأمرني أن أكون؟ فأومأ إلى الشام ، فقال : هرم كيف المعيشة بها؟ قال : أويس أف لهذه القلوب قد خالطها الشك

BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r7.claim: An unattributed Persian couplet depicts a person living as if lodged in a grave, with no grief over death or winter provisions.
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r7.anchor: قال من قال : خانه ركندم ويك جونفر ستاده بكور

BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r8.claim: Only special divine enabling removes this doubt; a complete spiritual guide must train the self because he knows its benefits and harms.
BURSEVI:v3p206#3/r8.anchor: وهذا الشك لا يزول إلا بالتوفيق الخاص الإلهي ولا بد من تربية المرشد الكامل فإنه أعرف بمصالح النفس ومفاسدها

DURR-FULL:v3p594/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v3p594/r9.speaker: الحسن
DURR-FULL:v3p594/r9.claim: Al-Hasan says those who uphold the Book are the believers among them.
DURR-FULL:v3p594/r9.anchor: عن الحسن في قوله {والذين يمسكون بالكتاب} قال: هي لأهل الإيمان منهم

DURR-FULL:v3p594/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v3p594/r10.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v3p594/r10.claim: Mujahid identifies those who uphold the Book as some Jews and Christians.
DURR-FULL:v3p594/r10.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله {والذين يمسكون بالكتاب} قال: من اليهود والنصارى

DURR-FULL:v3p595/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v3p595/r1.speaker: ابن زيد
DURR-FULL:v3p595/r1.claim: Ibn Zayd identifies the Book as the one Moses brought.
DURR-FULL:v3p595/r1.anchor: عن ابن زيد في قوله {والذين يمسكون بالكتاب} قال: الذي جاء به موسى عليه السلام

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r1.speaker: مجاهد
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r1.claim: Mujahid identifies those who hold fast to the Book as Jews and Christians.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد والذين يمسكون بالكتاب قال : اليهود والنصارى

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r2.speaker: الحسن
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r2.claim: Al-Hasan identifies them as the believers among the earlier communities.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r2.anchor: عن الحسن قوله : والذين يمسكون بالكتاب قال : يعني لاهل الايمان منهم

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r3.speaker: عبد الرحمن بن زيد بن أسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r3.claim: Ibn Zayd identifies the Book as the one given to Moses.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r3.anchor: سمعت عبد الرحمن بن زيد بن اسلم يقول في قول الله : والذين يمسكون بالكتاب الذي جاء به موسى

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r4.speaker: الزهري
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r4.claim: Al-Zuhri says establishing prayer means praying at its proper time.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r4.anchor: عن الزهري قال : اقامتها ان تصلي الصلاة لوقتها

IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r5.speaker: الحسن
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r5.claim: Al-Hasan says the promise not to waste the reformers' reward concerns the believers among them.
IBNABIHATIM:v5p1609/r5.anchor: عن الحسن قوله : انا لا نضيع اجر المصلحين قال : هي لاهل الايمان منهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r2.claim: The verse follows as a contrast: after condemning those who abandoned the covenant, it promises reward to those who uphold Scripture and its prophetic message.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r2.anchor: ووقعت جملة : { والذين يمسكون بالكتاب } إلى آخرها عقب التي قبلها : لأن مضمونها مقابل حكم التي قبلها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r3.claim: Establishing prayer is a metonym for accepting Muhammad, since prayer marks Islam and Muslims are called the people of the qibla; Ibn Ashur identifies these people as Jews awaiting and then believing the foretold final messenger, such as Abdullah ibn Salam.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r3.anchor: فكني عن الإيمان بمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم بإقامة الصلاة ، لأن الصلاة شعار دين الإسلام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r4.claim: Ibn Ashur also allows that the verse addresses Muslims, praising them as successful in the afterlife and assuring them they will not treat their Scripture as the Jews treated theirs.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r4.anchor: ويحتمل أن المراد بالذين يمسكون بالكتاب : المسلمون ، ثناء عليهم بأنهم الفائزون في الآخرة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r5.claim: The final sentence reports God's promise to those who hold fast; they are the reformers, left implicit because the description already includes them and the omission gives concise praise.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v9p163/r5.anchor: وجملة : { إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين } خبر عن الذين يمسكون ، والمصلحون هم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r3.claim: Wa-lladhīna is coordinated with alladhīna yattaqūn in the previous verse.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r3.anchor: وقوله: والذين عطف على قوله: للذين يتقون

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r4.speaker: ابن كثير ونافع وحمزة والكسائي وعاصم وأبو عمرو
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r4.claim: These readers use yumassikūn with fatḥa on mīm and doubled sīn.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r4.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير ونافع وحمزة والكسائي وعاصم في رواية حفص وأبو عمرو والناس: «يمسكون» بفتح الميم وشد السين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r5.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب وأبو العالية وعاصم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r5.claim: Umar, Abu al-Aliyya, and Asim in Abu Bakr's transmission read yumiskūn with still mīm and a light sīn.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r5.anchor: عاصم وحده في رواية أبي بكر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r6.speaker: الجمهور وأبو عمرو
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r6.claim: For 60:10, the readers lighten sīn in wa-lā tamassakū except Abu Amr, who reads it with doubled sīn.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r6.anchor: وكلهم خفف ولا تمسكوا بعصم الكوافر [الممتحنة: 10] إلا أبا عمرو فإنه قرأ: «ولا تمسكوا» بفتح الميم وشد السين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r9.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r9.claim: Amsaka and masaka are two Arabic forms with the same meaning.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r9.anchor: يقال أمسك ومسك وهما لغتان بمعنى واحد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r10.claim: The doubled sīn construction occurs with the transitive preposition bi.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r10.anchor: أما أن شد السين يجري مع التعدي بالباء

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r11.speaker: كعب بن زهير
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r11.claim: Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr's verse uses tamassaka bi with a covenant, illustrating holding fast to it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p473/r11.anchor: فما تمسك بالعهد الذي زعمت ... إلا كما تمسك الماء الغرابيل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r1.speaker: ابن كثير ونافع وابن عامر وحمزة والكسائي وحفص عن عاصم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r1.claim: These readers pronounce يمسكون with gemination and read ولا تمسكوا in 60:10 without gemination.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r1.anchor: قرأ ابن كثير ونافع وابن عامر وحمزة والكسائي وحفص عن عاصم يمسكون مشددة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r2.speaker: أبو عمرو
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r2.claim: Abū ʿAmr reads both cited forms with gemination.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r3.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r3.claim: Abū Bakr reports from ʿĀṣim that both cited forms are read without gemination.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r3.anchor: وروى أبو بكر عن عاصم أنه خففهما

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r4.speaker: ابن الأنباري
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r4.claim: Ibn al-Anbārī notes the Arabic uses مسكت بالشيء and several forms with تَمَسُّك for holding fast to something.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r4.anchor: ويقال مسكت بالشيء وتمسكت به واستمسكت به وامتسكت به

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r5.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r5.claim: The verse was revealed about believing People of the Book, including ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām and his companions, who kept the Book’s limits and did not distort it.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r5.anchor: وهذه الآية نزلت في مؤمني اهل الكتاب الذين حفظوا حدوده ولم يحرفوه منهم عبد الله بن سلام واصحابه

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r6.speaker: ابن الأنباري
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r6.claim: Ibn al-Anbārī parses إنا and what follows as the predicate of الذين, with an implicit pronoun after المصلحين; the conditional promise reflects that some of them were not righteous.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r6.anchor: قال ابن الانباري وخبر الذين إنا وما بعده وله ضمير مقدر بعد المصلحين

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r7.speaker: بعض النحويين
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r7.claim: Some grammarians make المصلحون refer back to الذين: the sense is that God will not waste their reward, with the pronoun replaced by المصلحين; a poetic line illustrates the overt pronoun.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p282/r7.anchor: وقال بعض النحويين المصلحون يرجعون على الذين وتلخيص المعنى عنده

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p499/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p499/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p499/r3.claim: Those who hold fast to scripture follow its commands, avoid its prohibitions, and are led by it to follow Muhammad as scripture foretells.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p499/r3.anchor: ثم أثنى تعالى على من تمسك بكتابه الذي يقوده إلى اتباع رسوله محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، كما هو مكتوب فيه،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p499/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p499/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p499/r4.claim: God promises not to waste the reward of those who reform by adhering to scripture and establishing prayer.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v3p499/r4.anchor: والذين يمسكون بالكتاب} أي: اعتصموا به واقتدوا بأوامره، وتركوا زواجره {وأقاموا الصلاة إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين}

JISHUMI:v4p2765/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r1.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم وعمر بن الخطاب وأبو العالية
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r1.claim: Abu Bakr from Asim, Umar, and Abu al-Aliya read يمسكون with a light mīm, from يمسك.
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r1.anchor: قرأ أبو بكر عن عاصم يمسكون مخففة

JISHUMI:v4p2765/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r2.speaker: أبو عبيد وأبو حاتم
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r2.claim: The remaining readers use the doubled form, preferred by Abu Ubayd and Abu Hatim: مسكت بالشيء but أمسكته without bi.
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r2.anchor: قرأ الباقون بالتشديد، وهو اختيار أبي عبيد، وأبي حاتم

JISHUMI:v4p2765/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r3.speaker: الأعمش
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r3.claim: Al-Amash has the variant والذين استمسكوا بالكتاب.

JISHUMI:v4p2765/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r4.speaker: أبي بن كعب
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r4.claim: Ubayy ibn Kab reads تمسكوا بالقراءة.
JISHUMI:v4p2765/r4.anchor: وعن أبي بن كعب: تمسكوا بالقراءة

MUJAHID:v1p249#3/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v1p249#3/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v1p249#3/r1.claim: Those who hold fast to the Book are Jews and Christians.
MUJAHID:v1p249#3/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله ﴿ والذين يمسكون بالكتاب ﴾ يعني اليهود والنصارى

NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r1.speaker: أبو بكر
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r1.claim: Abū Bakr reads the word as yumsikūn; the related forms mean holding fast, clinging, and attaching oneself to something.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r1.anchor: يمسكون أبو بكر والامسكاك والتمسيك والتمسك الاعتصام والتعلق بشئ

NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r2.claim: Prayer is singled out even though holding to the Book includes every act of worship, because prayer is religion's pillar.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r2.anchor: خص الصلاة مع أن التمسك بالكتاب يشتمل على ككل عبادة لانها عما الدين

NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r3.claim: Wa-alladhīna may begin a clause whose predicate is إنّا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r3.anchor: لانها عما الدين مبتدأ والخبر ﴿ إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين ﴾ أى انا لا نضيع أجرهم

NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r4.claim: Alternatively, wa-alladhīna is genitive by coordination with الذين يتقون, and the assurance that God does not waste their reward is parenthetical.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p45/r4.anchor: وجاز أن يكون مجرورا عطفا على الذين يتقون وأنا لا نضيع اعتراض

QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r1.claim: Holding to the Book means acting by the Torah; مسك به and تمسك به mean to cling to it.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r1.anchor: أي بالتوراة، أي بالعمل بها يقال: مسك به وتمسك به أي استمسك به

QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r2.speaker: أبو العالية وعاصم في رواية أبي بكر
QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r2.claim: Abu al-Aliya and Asim in Abu Bakr's transmission read the verb lightly, from أمسك يمسك.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r2.anchor: وقرأ أبو العالية وعاصم في رواية أبي بكر «يمسكون» بالتخفيف من أمسك يمسك

QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r3.claim: Qurtubi prefers the doubled form for its iterative force: adherence requires persistence; Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr likens broken covenants to water held in sieves.
QURTUBI-FULL:7:170/r3.anchor: والقراءة الأولى أولى لأن فيها معنى التكرير والتكثير للتمسك بكتاب الله تعالى وبدينه

RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r4.claim: The verb appears in several forms, including masaktu, tamassaktu, istamsaktu, and imtasaktu bihi, all meaning holding fast.
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r4.anchor: يقال مسكت بالشيء وتمسكت به واستمسكت به وامتسكت به

RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r5.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r5.claim: Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim reads without doubling; others double it, supported by usage at 2:229, 33:37, and 5:4.
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r5.anchor: وقرأ أبو بكر عن عاصم { يمسكون } مخففة والباقون بالتشديد . أما حجة عاصم فقوله تعالى : { فإمساك بمعروف }

RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r6.speaker: الواحدي
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r6.claim: Al-Wāḥidī prefers doubling because it conveys abundant holding fast as intended here, and أمسكته is more common than أمسكت به.
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r6.anchor: قال الواحدي : والتشديد أقوى ، لأن التشديد للكثرة وههنا أريد به الكثرة

RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r7.claim: On one parsing, those who hold the Book are the subject and God's promise is their predicate; warning is followed by promise, as at 18:30.
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r7.anchor: وهذا الوجه حسن لأنه لما ذكر وعيد من ترك التمسك بالكتاب أردفه بوعد من تمسك به

RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r8.claim: Alternatively, the phrase is genitive, coordinated with those who fear at the end of the previous verse; the promise is added as reinforcement.
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r8.anchor: أن يكون مجرورا عطفا على قوله : { الذين يتقون } ويكون قوله : { إنا لا نضيع }

RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r9.claim: Prayer is singled out although holding the Book entails all worship, to show its rank as the greatest worship after faith.
RAZI-FULL:v15p37/r9.anchor: إظهارا لعلو مرتبة الصلاة ، وأنها أعظم العبادات بعد الإيمان

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r1.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r1.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r1.claim: Holding fast to the Book is faith and establishing prayer is excellence: faith brings immediate safety, while excellence brings deferred divine pleasure.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r1.anchor: يمسكون بالكتاب إيمانا ، وأقاموا الصلاة إحسانا ، فبالإيمان وجدوا الأمان ، وبالإحسان وجدوا الرضوان ؛ فالأمان معجل والرضوان مؤجل

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r2.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r2.speaker: ويقال
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r2.claim: Holding to the Book is the means of salvation, and prayer establishes intimate communion; salvation is in the end, communion in the present.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r2.anchor: ويقال { يمسكون بالكتاب } سبب النجاة ، وإقامة الصلاة تحقق المناجاة . فالنجاة في المآل والمناجاة في الحال

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r3.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r3.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r3.claim: Prayer is singled out from all acts of obedience to show that it is the best worship after knowing God’s essence and attributes.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r3.anchor: ويقال أفرد الصلاة ها هنا بالذكر عن جملة الطاعات ليعلم أنها أفضل العبادات بعد معرفة الذات والصفات

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r4.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r4.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r4.claim: Whoever hopes in the means of God’s generosity will not lose the bargain or be disappointed in hope.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r4.anchor: من أمل سبب إنعامنا لم تخسر له صفقة ، ولم تخفق له في الرجاء رفقة

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r5.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r5.speaker: ويقال
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r5.claim: One who directs a step toward God’s door will not lack His blessing in the next life.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r5.anchor: ويقال من نقل ( . . . ) إلى بابه قدمه لم يعدم في الآجل نعمه

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r6.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r6.speaker: ويقال
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r6.claim: Raising one’s aspirations to God’s generosity wins His favor in the present.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r6.anchor: ومن رفع إلى ساحات جوده هممه نال في الحال كرمه

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r7.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r7.speaker: ويقال
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r7.claim: Reaching God through His generosity brings honor in both worlds, and relying on His generosity makes Him sufficient as one’s support.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r7.anchor: ويقال من توصل غليه بجوده نال في الدارين شرفه . ومن اكتفى بجوده كان الله عنه خلفه

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r8.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r8.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r8.claim: Voluntary obedience differs from coerced obedience, since the coerced servant does not recognize God’s due worth; an anonymous poem questions affection that needs an advocate.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r8.anchor: ليس من يأتي طوعا كمن يأتي جبرا ، فإن الذي يأتي قهرا لا يعرف للحق - سبحانه - قدرا ، وفي معناه أنشدوا

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r9.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r9.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r9.claim: A poem says admonishing a fickle person is like writing on water, and even if the person relents, affection that becomes forced was not natural.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r9.anchor: إذا أنا عاتبت الملول فإنما . . . أخط بأقلامي على الماء أحرفا وهبه ارعوى بعد العتاب

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r10.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r10.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r10.claim: Those made to accept the Book under compulsion soon answered it with distortion.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r10.anchor: كذلك لما قابلوا الكتاب بالإجبار ما لبثوا حتى قابلوه بالتحريف

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r11.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r11.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r11.claim: The verse recalls God’s prior covenant and true promise, confirming His loving care by making His servants know Him.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r11.anchor: أخبر هذه الآية عن سابق عهده ، وصادق وعده ، وتأكيد عناج وده ، بتعريف عبده

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r12.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r12.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r12.claim: God grants realization of gnosis before any creature sees the servants, any created effect appears in their hearts, or they hear from a relative or friend.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r12.anchor: ويقال فأجابهم بتحقيق العرفان قبل أن يقع لمخلوق عليهم بصر ، أو ظهر في قلوبهم لمصنوع أثر

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r13.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r13.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r13.claim: A poem compares divine love arriving before one even knows love to finding an empty heart ready to receive it.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r13.anchor: وفي معناه أنشدوا : أتاني هواها قبل أن أعرف الهوى . . . فصادق قلبا فارغا فتمكنا

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r14.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r14.speaker: ويقال
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r14.claim: God gathers people in one address but differentiates their inward states.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r14.anchor: ويقال جمعهم في الخطاب ولكنه فرقهم في الحال

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r15.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r15.speaker: ويقال
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r15.claim: Some are addressed with nearness and recognize God through the address, while others remain in absence, separated from gnosis and veiled.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r15.anchor: وطائفة خاطبهم بوصف القربة فعرفهم في نفس ما خاطبهم ، وفرقة أبقاهم في أوطان الغيبة فأقصاهم عن نعت العرفان وحجبهم

QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r16.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r16.speaker: ويقال
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r16.claim: Some are gently unveiled and affirm tawhid; others are distanced even as they witness, and affirm denial.
QUSHAYRI:v1p365/r16.anchor: ويقال أقوام لاطفهم في عين ما كاشفهم فأقروا بنعت التوحيد ، وآخرون أبعدهم في نفس ما أشهدهم فأقروا عن رأس الجحود

STUDYQURAN:7:170/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:7:170/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:7:170/r1.claim: Clinging to the Book means continuing to follow the Torah’s teachings, commands, and prohibitions.
STUDYQURAN:7:170/r1.anchor: Those who cling to the Book means those who continue to adhere to the teachings, commands, and prohibitions established in the Torah

STUDYQURAN:7:170/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:7:170/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:7:170/r2.claim: God will not fail to reward the righteous for their deeds.
STUDYQURAN:7:170/r2.anchor: That God does not neglect . . . the reward of those who are righteous means that He will not fail to reward them for their deeds

STUDYQURAN:7:170/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:7:170/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:7:170/r3.claim: Jews who continue to follow Torah and Mosaic law will be rewarded for good deeds, as affirmed for Jews, Sabeans, and Christians who believe and act righteously.
STUDYQURAN:7:170/r3.anchor: those who are Jews and continue to follow the Torah and Mosaic Law will be rewarded for their good deeds

TAB-FULL:v10p542/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r1.speaker: بعض القراء
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r1.claim: Some reciters read yumsikūn with a light, silent mīm, from amsaka/yumsiku.
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r1.anchor: فقرأه بعضهم: (يمسكون) بتخفيف الميم وتسكينها، من أمسك يمسك

TAB-FULL:v10p542/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r2.speaker: آخرون من القراء
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r2.claim: Other reciters read yumassikūn with a doubled sīn, from massaka/yumassiku.
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r2.anchor: وقرأه آخرون: {يمسكون} [الأعراف: 170] بفتح الميم وتشديد السين، من مسك يمسك

TAB-FULL:v10p542/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r3.claim: The verse praises those who act by God's Book and establish prayer within its bounds without neglecting its times; God does not forfeit reformers' reward.
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r3.anchor: ويعني بذلك: والذين يعملون بما في كتاب الله، وأقاموا الصلاة بحدودها، ولم يضيعوا أوقاتها

TAB-FULL:v10p542/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r4.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r4.claim: Ibn Zayd identifies the Book they hold fast to as the Book God gave Moses.
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r4.anchor: قال ابن زيد: " {والذين يمسكون بالكتاب} [الأعراف: 170] قال: كتاب الله الذي جاء به موسى

TAB-FULL:v10p542/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r5.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r5.claim: Mujāhid says those holding fast to the Book may be Jews or Christians.
TAB-FULL:v10p542/r5.anchor: عن ابن جريج، قال: قال مجاهد، قوله: " {والذين يمسكون بالكتاب} [الأعراف: 170] من يهود أو نصارى

TABATABAI:7:170/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:170/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:170/r1.claim: Al-Majmaʿ says amsaka, massaka, tamassaka, and istamsaka all mean to hold fast or adhere to something.
TABATABAI:7:170/r1.anchor: أمسك ومسك وتمسك واستمسك بالشيء بمعنى واحد أي اعتصم به

TABATABAI:7:170/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:170/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:170/r2.claim: Prayer is singled out for its rank as a pillar of religion that preserves remembrance of God and submission to Him, the living spirit of religious law.
TABATABAI:7:170/r2.anchor: وتخصيص إقامة الصلاة بالذكر من بين سائر أجزاء الدين لشرفها وكونها ركنا من الدين يحفظ بها ذكر الله

TABATABAI:7:170/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:170/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:170/r3.claim: The verse calls adherence to scripture reform; social corruption comes from corrupting human nature, while divine scripture contains the religion suited to that nature and the needs of life.
TABATABAI:7:170/r3.anchor: الآية تعد التمسك بالكتاب إصلاحا والإصلاح يقابل الإفساد وهو الإفساد في الأرض

TABATABAI:7:170-171/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:170-171/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:170-171/r1.claim: The claim that God's religion does not serve human welfare is ignorance and slander: divine law comprises rules that reform human action and society, and following the created natural path is submission to God.
TABATABAI:7:170-171/r1.anchor: وبالجملة الكتاب الإلهي يتضمن مصالح العباد، وفيه ما يصلح المجتمع الإنساني بإجرائه فيه

TABATABAI:7:170-171/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:7:170-171/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:7:170-171/r2.claim: The verse is general and independent in itself, though its setting addresses Israelites; in that setting, the Book means the Torah or the Torah together with the Gospel.
TABATABAI:7:170-171/r2.anchor: والآية أعني قوله { والذين يمسكون بالكتاب } الآية في نفسها عامة مستقلة لكنها بحسب دخولها في سياق الكلام في بني إسرائيل

TABRISI:7:169-170/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:169-170/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:169-170/r1.claim: Abū Bakr reads yumsikūn with still mīm; other readers use open mīm and geminated sīn, with the same meaning.
TABRISI:7:169-170/r1.anchor: القراءة: قرأ أبو بكر يمسكون بتسكين الميم والباقون

TABRISI:7:169-170/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:169-170/r10.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:169-170/r10.claim: Amsaka, masaka, tamassaka, and istamsaka all mean to hold fast to something.
TABRISI:7:169-170/r10.anchor: وأمسك ومسك وتمسك واستمسك بالشيء بمعنى واحد

TABRISI:7:169-170/r13.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:169-170/r13.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:169-170/r13.claim: The predicate of alladhīna yumsikūn is innā lā nuḍīʿu ajra al-muṣliḥīn, with minhum omitted as context supplies it.
TABRISI:7:169-170/r13.anchor: فحذف منهم لدلالة الكلام عليه كما في قوله السمن منوان بدرهم

TABRISI:7:169-170/r14.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:169-170/r14.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:169-170/r14.claim: Alternatively, it means “We do not waste their reward” because they reform; or the predicate is omitted and the reason stands for the result.
TABRISI:7:169-170/r14.anchor: ويحتمل أن يكون التقدير لا نضيع أجرهم لأن المصلحين هم الذين يمسكون بالكتاب

TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r6.speaker: مجاهد وابن زيد
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r6.claim: Mujāhid and Ibn Zayd say the Book is the Torah, which its adherents preserve without altering or concealing.
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r6.anchor: أي لا يحرفونه ولا يكتمونه عن مجاهد وابن زيد

TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r7.speaker: عطاء
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r7.claim: ʿAṭāʾ identifies the Book as the Qurʾān and its adherents as Muḥammad’s community.
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r7.anchor: وقيل: الكتاب القرآن والمتمسك به أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم عن عطاء

TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r9.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r9.claim: Prayer is singled out because of its high rank or especially strong obligation.
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r9.anchor: إنما خص الصلاة بالذكر لجلالة موقعها أو شدة تأكدها

TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r10.speaker: author
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r10.claim: God does not waste reformers’ reward but recompenses their work as they deserve.
TABRISI:7:169-170#2/r10.anchor: أي لا نضيع جزاء عملهم ونثيبهم على ما يستحقونه

FARRA:v1p397/r17.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v1p397/r17.speaker: author
FARRA:v1p397/r17.claim: A reading has يمسكون بالكتاب, which al-Farrāʾ explains as adhering to what the Book contains.
FARRA:v1p397/r17.anchor: ويقرأ يمسكون بالكتاب ومعناه: يأخذون بما فيه.

THALABI:v4p301/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p301/r5.speaker: author
THALABI:v4p301/r5.claim: Umar, Abu al-Aliya, Asim, and Abu Bakr's transmission read with a light form; the remaining readers use the doubled form.
THALABI:v4p301/r5.anchor: قرأ عمر بن الخطاب وأبو العالية وعاصم ورواية أبي بكر بسكون خفيفة. وقرأ الباقون بسكون التشديد

THALABI:v4p301/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p301/r6.speaker: أبو عبيد وأبو حاتم
THALABI:v4p301/r6.claim: Abu Ubayd and Abu Hatim argue for تمسك because Arabic takes the preposition بِ with it, and cite Ubayy ibn Kaʿb's past-tense reading as support for the coordination with أقاموا.
THALABI:v4p301/r6.anchor: قال أبو عبيد وأبو حاتم: لأنه يقال تمسكت بالشيء ولا يقال أمسكت بالشيء

THALABI:v4p301/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p301/r7.speaker: أبي بن كعب
THALABI:v4p301/r7.claim: Ubayy ibn Kaʿb reads مسكوا in the past tense; the author calls this a good reading because it suits the coordination with أقاموا.
THALABI:v4p301/r7.anchor: قراءة أبي ابن كعب (والذين مسكوا الكتاب) على الماضي وهو جيد لقوله: (وأقاموا الصلاة)

THALABI:v4p301/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p301/r9.speaker: مجاهد وابن زيد
THALABI:v4p301/r9.claim: Mujahid and Ibn Zayd identify them as Jews and Christians who keep the scripture of Moses unaltered, neither concealing it nor violating its lawful and forbidden rulings.
THALABI:v4p301/r9.anchor: قال مجاهد وابن زيد: هم من اليهود والنصارى الذين يمسكون بالكتاب الذي جاء به موسى فلا يحرفونه ولا يكتمونه

THALABI:v4p301/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p301/r10.speaker: عطاء
THALABI:v4p301/r10.claim: Ata says Muhammad is among those who hold to the scripture; the nearby text also associates the verse with Abd Allah ibn Salam and his companions.
THALABI:v4p301/r10.anchor: في عبد الله بن سلام وأصحابه، وقال عطاء: فيهم أنه محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

THALABI:v4p301/r11.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v4p301/r11.speaker: author
THALABI:v4p301/r11.claim: The verse commends acting according to God's book, keeping its rulings, and establishing prayer; God does not waste reformers' reward.
THALABI:v4p301/r11.anchor: ومعنى الآية: وأن يعملوا بما في كتاب الله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r1.claim: Arabic usage permits several equivalent expressions for holding fast to something.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r1.anchor: يقال: مسكت (¬1) بالشيء، وتمسكت به، واستمسكت به، وامتسكت به

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r2.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r2.claim: Abu Bakr transmits from Asim a light, un-doubled reading of يمسكون.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r2.anchor: وروى أبو بكر عن عاصم (¬3) {يمسكون} مخففه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r3.claim: The doubled reading is stronger because it conveys thorough adherence, fitting belief in the whole Book; the author also notes the idiom أمسكته.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r3.anchor: والتشديد أقوى , لأن التشديد للكثرة، وهاهنا أريد به الكثرة لأنه قال في موضع آخر: {وتؤمنون بالكتاب كله}

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r4.speaker: أبو بكر عن عاصم
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r4.claim: The light reading is supported by cited forms meaning holding or retaining.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r4.anchor: وحجته قوله: {فإمساك بمعروف} [البقرة: 229]، وقوله: {أمسك عليك زوجك} (¬4) [الأحزاب: 37]

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r5.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r5.claim: Ataa reports from Ibn Abbas that those holding fast to the Book are Muhammad's community.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r5.anchor: قال عطاء عن ابن عباس: (يريد: أمة محمد - صلى الله عليه وسلم -)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r6.speaker: عامة المفسرين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r6.claim: Most exegetes identify them as believing People of the Book, with the Book meaning the Torah; on Ataa's view it means the Quran.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r6.anchor: وقال عامة المفسرين (¬2): (نزلت في مؤمني أهل الكتاب). فعلى قول عطاء المراد بالكتاب: القرآن

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r7.speaker: الفراء
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r7.claim: Al-Farra glosses holding to the Book as taking what it contains.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r8.speaker: الزجاج
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r8.claim: Al-Zajjaj says it means believing in the Book and judging by it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r8.anchor: وقال الزجاج: (أي: يؤمنون به ويحكمون بما فيه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r9.speaker: غيره
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r9.claim: Another exegete compares adherence to the Book to clutching something from which one hopes for deliverance and success.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p435/r9.anchor: وقال غيره: (التمسك بالكتاب ارتباط به على ما بين فيه، كالقابض على الشيء الذي يرجو النجاة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r1.claim: Prayer is mentioned although included in adherence to the Book to show its high rank in obedience and the special importance of guarding it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r1.anchor: إنما ذكرت {الصلاة} مع دخولها في التمسك بالكتاب للبيان عن جلالة موقعها، وعظم منزلتها في طاعة الله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r2.speaker: قوم من النحويين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r2.claim: One grammatical analysis coordinates this clause with the preceding statement about the better Hereafter for the God-fearing.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r2.anchor: فقال قوم: هذه الآية معطوفة على ما قبلها، والتقدير: {والدار الآخرة خير للذين يتقون}، {والذين يمسكون بالكتاب}

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r3.speaker: الأكثرون من النحويين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r3.claim: Most grammarians parse الذين as a subject, then differ over its predicate.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r3.anchor: وقال الأكثرون منهم: {والذين} مبتدأ، ثم اختلفوا في خبره

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r4.speaker: قوم من النحويين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r4.claim: One group supplies an omitted predicate, نعطيهم أجرهم, inferred from the following promise's causal force.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r4.anchor: فقال قوم (¬1): خبره محذوف تقديره: {والذين يمسكون بالكتاب وأقاموا الصلاة} نعطيهم أجرهم، ودل على هذا المحذوف قوله: {إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين}

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r5.speaker: الزجاج
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r5.claim: Al-Zajjaj chooses إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين منهم as predicate, with منهم omitted as the return to the subject.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r5.anchor: وقال الزجاج: (الذي أختار أن يكون التقدير: {إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين}] (¬2) منهم)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r6.speaker: ابن الأنباري
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r6.claim: Ibn al-Anbari says reformers are singled out because some failed to reform, completing their sins by neglecting God's commands, denying prophets, and rejecting what foretold Muhammad.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r6.anchor: قال ابن الأنباري: (وخص {المصلحين} بأن وعدهم حفظ الأجر إذ كان منهم من لم يصلح فتكاملت آثامه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r7.speaker: بعض النحويين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r7.claim: Some grammarians take المصلحين as the overt return to the subject, meaning God will not waste their reward; cited usage and poetry make an omitted pronoun explicit.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r7.anchor: وقال بعض النحويين الراجع إلى المبتدأ قوله: {المصلحين}، وتلخيص المعنى: إنا لا نضيع أجرهم فأظهرت كنايتهم بالمصلحين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r8.speaker: أبو بكر
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r8.claim: Abu Bakr says the two analyses explain al-Zajjaj's statement and the first is his own choice.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v9p436/r8.anchor: وهذان الوجهان ذكرهما أبو بكر؛ معنى قول الزجاج (¬4) في هذه الآية، والأول منهما (¬5) اختياره

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r1.claim: Holding fast means believing the Book and judging by it; these are believers among the People of the Book.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r1.anchor: { والذين يمسكون بالكتاب } يؤمنون به ويحكمون بما فيه. يعني: مؤمني أهل الكتاب

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r2.claim: The prayer they establish is the prayer prescribed by Muhammad.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r2.anchor: { وأقاموا الصلاة } التي شرعها محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r3.claim: God does not waste the reward of the reformers.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:7:170-171/r3.anchor: { إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين } منهم.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r1.speaker: Kurtubî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r1.claim: Qurtubi identifies the Book as the Torah and those who hold to it and pray as Jews living according to their scripture.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r1.anchor: Kitaptan maksat Tevrat, kitaba sarılıp namazı kılanlardan maksat da kutsal kitaplarının hükümlerine uygun yaşayan yahudilerdir (Kurtubî, VII, 313).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r2.speaker: Şevkânî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r2.claim: Although some among the People of the Book studied scripture without acting on it, others adhered to the Torah and consulted it on religious matters; these are the righteous whose reward is not lost.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r2.anchor: Âyette Allah’ın ecirlerini zayi etmeyeceğini bildirdiği iyiler bunlardır (Şevkânî, II, 298).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r3.speaker: Râzî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r3.claim: Prayer is already among the Book’s commands, but its separate mention emphasizes its importance.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r3.anchor: Kuşkusuz namaz kılmak da kitabın buyruklarından olmakla birlikte âyette ayrıca zikredilerek bu ibadetin önemine özellikle işaret edilmiştir (Râzî, XV, 44).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r4.speaker: İbn Âşûr
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r4.claim: Ibn Ashur argues that prayer is specific to Islam and suggests the verse concerns Jewish-origin people who recognized Jesus but rejected distorted Christianity, then believed Muhammad, or perhaps Muslims.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r4.anchor: İbn Âşûr, âyette namaz ibadetinden bahsedildiğini, namazın ise Müslümanlığa mahsus bir ibadet olduğunu ifade ederek

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r5.claim: The author prefers reading salat in its lexical sense of prayer or ritual, referring in context to Jews who fulfill their religion’s requirements.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r5.anchor: Oysa salât kelimesinin burada “dua, âyin” şeklindeki sözlük anlamında kullanıldığını, dolayısıyla âyette dinlerinin gereklerini yerine getiren yahudilerin kastedildiğini düşünmek mümkündür.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r6.speaker: Râgıb el-İsfahânî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r6.claim: Al-Isfahani notes that prayer, though differently performed, exists in all revealed religions, supporting a Jewish referent here.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r6.anchor: Râgıb el-İsfahânî’nin de ifade ettiği gibi (el-Müfredât, “slv” md.)– namaz, şekli farklı da olsa bütün ilâhî dinlerde bulunan ibadetlerden biridir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r7.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r7.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r7.claim: The preceding verses linked Jewish greed for wealth with abandoning religious commands; this verse continues the discussion by identifying those who remain faithful.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r7.anchor: Bundan önceki âyetlerde yahudilerin dünya malı konusundaki hırs ve zaafları ile dinlerinin hükümlerinden uzaklaşıp kötülüklere sapmaları arasındaki ilişkiye işaret edilmişti.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r8.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r8.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r8.claim: The promise hints at a strong tendency toward corruption among the Jews but assures full reward to those who overcome it and work for good and peace.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r8.anchor: bu kavimde bozgunculuk temayülünün baskın olduğuna imada bulunulmakta, bu temayüllerini yenerek iyilik ve sulh için çalışmaları halinde bunun karşılığını yüce Allah’ın kendilerine eksiksiz vereceği ifade buyurulmakta

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r9.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r9.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r9.claim: The general wording makes the promise applicable to everyone who fulfills its condition, not only to Jews.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:170/r9.anchor: O’nun bu hükmü, gereğini yerine getiren herkes için geçerli olduğu için âyette bu husus genel bir ifadeyle dile getirilmektedir.

BURHAN:v2p465/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p465/r1.speaker: أبو جعفر بن الزبير
BURHAN:v2p465/r1.claim: Abū Jaʿfar ibn al-Zubayr calls this coordination tajrīd: a phrase is detached from a general statement and singled out for fuller detail.
BURHAN:v2p465/r1.anchor: حكى الشيخ أثير الدين عن شيخه أبي جعفر بن الزبير أنه كان يقول إن هذا العطف يسمى بالتجريد

BURHAN:v2p465/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p465/r2.speaker: ابن مالك
BURHAN:v2p465/r2.claim: Ibn Mālik sets two conditions for this construction: coordination by و and a special item that has a distinguishing merit.
BURHAN:v2p465/r2.anchor: وله شرطان ذكرهما ابن مالك أحدهما كون العف بالواو والثاني كون المعطوف ذا مزية

BURHAN:v2p465/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p465/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p465/r3.claim: One view says the preceding general term includes the specially coordinated item, as the apparent wording suggests, comparable to نعم الرجل زيد.
BURHAN:v2p465/r3.anchor: فعلى القول الأول يكون هذا نظير مسألة نعم الرجل زيد على المشهور فيه وهو الظاهر من لفظ العام

BURHAN:v2p465/r4.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p465/r4.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p465/r4.claim: The other view says the general term excludes the special item, whose separate mention signals restriction, like an exception; Zarkashī says a cited poem may strengthen this reading, though it is not itself general-to-specific coordination.
BURHAN:v2p465/r4.anchor: وعلى الثاني يكون عطف الخاص قرينه دالة على إرادة التخصيص في العام وأنه لم يتناوله وهو نظير بحث الاستثناء

BURHAN:v2p465/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p465/r5.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p465/r5.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī signals both readings in the poetry-and-palm-trees verse; Zarkashī says both are possible there because جنات is indefinite rather than generic.
BURHAN:v2p465/r5.anchor: وقد اشار الزمخشري إلى القولين في سورة الشعراء

BURHAN:v2p465/r8.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p465/r8.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p465/r8.claim: Holding to scripture already includes every act of worship, including prayer, but prayer is singled out to show its rank as the pillar of religion.
BURHAN:v2p465/r8.anchor: لكن خصها بالذكر إظهارا لمرتبتها لكونها عماد الدين

ITQAN:v3p191/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p191/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p191/r1.claim: Naming a specific after a general highlights its excellence, treating the distinction in quality as if it were a distinction in kind; examples include prayer and Gabriel with Michael.
ITQAN:v3p191/r1.anchor: وفائدته التنبيه على فضله حتى كأنه ليس من جنس العام تنزيلا للتغاير في الوصف منزلة التغاير في الذات

ITQAN:v3p191/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p191/r2.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p191/r2.claim: Prayer is included in holding fast to the Book but is singled out to display its rank as the pillar of religion.
ITQAN:v3p191/r2.anchor: فإن إقامتها من جملة التمسك بالكتاب وخصت بالذكر إظهارا لمرتبتها لكونها عماد الدين

ITQAN:v3p197/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p197/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p197/r1.claim: Repeating an explicit expression with a synonym is better than repeating its exact wording; al-Aʿrāf’s “reward of the reformers” is restated in Hūd as “reward of whoever does good.”
ITQAN:v3p197/r1.anchor: إعادة الظاهر بمعناه أحسن من إعادته بلفظه كما مر في آيات ﴿ إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين ﴾ ﴿ إنا لا نضيع أجر من أحسن عملا ﴾

ELMALILI:7:164-170#2/r17.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:7:164-170#2/r17.speaker: author
ELMALILI:7:164-170#2/r17.claim: Those who hold fast to the Book and establish prayer are reformers whose reward God will not let go to waste.

ELMALILI:7:164-170#2/r18.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:7:164-170#2/r18.speaker: author
ELMALILI:7:164-170#2/r18.claim: Elmalılı frames the following reminder as addressing two covenants: the one imposed on Israel and the universal covenant of primordial human nature.
ELMALILI:7:164-170#2/r18.anchor: biri Benî İsrâil’e yapılmış ilcâ mîsâkı olan, diğeri ale’l-umûm insanlara şâmil fıtrat mîsâkı

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:167/r9.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:167/r9.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:167/r9.claim: Condemning an entire people is irrational and unethical, conflicts with Qur'anic justice, and ignores Israel's hope of mercy in 17:4–8 if they do not return to evil; verses 168–170 affirm justice for Jews and all people.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:7:167/r9.anchor: bir toplumu bu şekilde toptan mahkûm etmek hem aklen ve ahlâken doğru değildir hem de bizzat Kur’an-ı Kerîm’in herkese ve her topluma hak ettiği şekilde muamele edileceğini ve hiçbir kimseye hiçbir şekilde haksızlık yapılmayacağını belirten açıklamalarına

BURHAN:v2p493/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p493/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p493/r1.claim: The explicit term المصلحين instead of their reward makes their reform the stated reason for their salvation.
BURHAN:v2p493/r1.anchor: ولم يقل أجرهم تنبيها على أن صلاحهم علة لنجاتهم

ITQAN:v3p269/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p269/r4.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p269/r4.claim: A manifest noun can replace a pronoun, as in the reference to the reward of the reformers; the source also points to an example in al-Kahf.
ITQAN:v3p269/r4.anchor: الثلاثون إيقاع الظاهر موضع المضمر نحو ﴿ والذين يمسكون بالكتاب وأقاموا الصلاة إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين ﴾

MAJAZ:v1p231/r7.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v1p231/r7.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v1p231/r7.claim: Nataqnā al-jabal means We raised the mountain above them. Al-ʿAjjāj and Ruʾba’s lines use nataqa for lifting or raising.
MAJAZ:v1p231/r7.anchor: «وإذ نتقنا الجبل فوقهم» (170) أي رفعنا فوقهم، وقال العجاج: ينتق أقتاد الشليل نتقا

SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p125/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p125/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p125/r1.claim: Reporting a general class for a named subgroup broadens the meaning: the subgroup belongs to that class, and the promise or judgment also covers others in it.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p125/r1.anchor: وهذا من باب التوسع بالمعنى وهو من إخبار بالعام عن الخاص

SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p125/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p125/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p125/r2.claim: Calling their reward the reward of reformers shows the addressed people are reformers and extends the promise to every reformer.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p125/r2.anchor: القياس أن يقول إنا لا نضيع أجرهم لأن المبتدأ يحتاج إلى رابط

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p574/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p574/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p574/r1.claim: Saying ‘the reward of the reformers’ instead of ‘their reward’ identifies the people mentioned as reformers and extends the promise to every reformer.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p574/r1.anchor: قال أجر المصلحين وهذا للدلالة على أن هؤلاء المذكورين في الآية هم من المصلحين

NASHR:v2p273/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p273/r1.speaker: أبو جعفر
NASHR:v2p273/r1.claim: Abu Jafar lightens the sīn in يمسكون; the other readers double it.
NASHR:v2p273/r1.anchor: فروى أبو جعفر بتخفيف السين، وقرأ الباقون بتشديدها

NASHR:v2p273/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p273/r2.speaker: الباقون
NASHR:v2p273/r2.claim: The remaining readers double the sīn in يمسكون.
NASHR:v2p273/r2.anchor: فروى أبو جعفر بتخفيف السين، وقرأ الباقون بتشديدها

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:168-170/r15.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:168-170/r15.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:168-170/r15.claim: Those who hold to the Book may coordinate with the God-fearing; alternatively they begin a sentence promising not to waste the reformers’ reward, or replace an implicit pronoun to stress reform.
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:168-170/r15.anchor: عطف على الذين { يتقون } وقوله: { أفلا يعقلون } اعتراض

BAYDAWI-FULL:7:168-170/r16.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:168-170/r16.speaker: أبو بكر
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:168-170/r16.claim: Abū Bakr reads yumsikūn lightly; prayer uses a singular verb because it surpasses other forms of adherence.
BAYDAWI-FULL:7:168-170/r16.anchor: وقرأ أبو بكر { يمسكون } بالتخفيف وإفراد الإقامة

MUQATIL:7:167-170/r10.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:7:167-170/r10.speaker: author
MUQATIL:7:167-170/r10.claim: Those who hold fast to the Book cling to the Torah, do not distort it or legalize the forbidden, and establish prayer; God does not waste the reformers' reward.
MUQATIL:7:167-170/r10.anchor: يعنى يتمسكون بالتوراة ولا يحرفونه عن مواضعه، ولا يستحلون محرما، { وأقاموا الصلاة إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين }

MUQATIL:7:167-170/r11.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:7:167-170/r11.speaker: author
MUQATIL:7:167-170/r11.claim: The verse was revealed about Ibn Salam and his companions.

BURHAN:v4p107/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p107/r5.speaker: ابن عمرون وغيره
BURHAN:v4p107/r5.claim: Ibn ʿUmarūn and others require coordinated verbs to agree in tense, but allow a tense shift by interpretation when context prevents confusion; the past here follows الذين and has a future or conditional force.
BURHAN:v4p107/r5.anchor: قال ابن عمرون وغيره يشترط فيه اتفاق زمانهما فإن خالف رد إلى الاتفاق بالتأويل لا سيما إذا كان لا يلبس وكانت مغايرة الصيغ اتساعا
